question: According to Nebular hypothesis, how does a galaxy form?

options.text: By the accumulation of hydrogen gas in the form of a very large cloud called nebula
By the accumulation of oxygen gas in the form of a very large cloud called nebula
By a fission reaction of hydrogen gas
By the accumulation of oxygen gas

solution:
The correct answer is"**__By the accumulation of hydrogen gas in the form of a very large cloud called a nebula."__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **nebular hypothesis was proposed in 1755** by** Immanuel Kant **
 
• According to the nebular hypothesis, massive** clouds of hydrogen and helium collapsed**.
 
• After the collapse, the centre of the cloud became hotter and hotter. 
 
• Then, as it got hotter and more condensed, the system began to rotate. This was the beginning of** the solar system's formation**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In our solar system,** Sun is described in the nebular hypothesis.**
 
• The nebular hypothesis totally elaborates the idea of a cloud of dust made of mostly light elements,** called a nebula, which** became a solar system consisting of a star with orbiting planets
